name: Fodder Development Scheme For Gram Panchayat, Gaushala And Panjarpol Having Gauchar Land
benefit: **Component****Standard of Assistance****Minimum Time Limit (in Years) for Reclaiming Constituent Benefits**Fodder Development Scheme for Gram Panchayat, Gaushala and Panjarapol having gauchar land For developing cow pastures in an area of up to 20 hectares are assisted with 75% of per hectare expenditure up to a maximum of ₹75,000/- i.e. A maximum assistance of ₹15,00,000/- for a total of 2
_eligibility_text:
1. Village panchayats having land for gauchar, gaushala and panjrapoles 
   1. Gauchar, gaushala and panjrapoles must be registered under the Public Charity Act.
